# lefdef
The subdirectory of lefdef, is a repository of def and lef parser, obtained from https://github.com/asyncvlsi/lefdef.git

# gdstk
The subdirectory of gdstk, is a C++ library for creation and manipulation of GDSII and OASIS files, obtained from https://github.com/heitzmann/gdstk.git

# entt
The subdirectory of entt is a curated copy of the header-only EnTT
entity-component system used by the database experiments in this repository.
It is obtained from https://github.com/skypjack/entt at release `v4.0.0`
(commit `85c6bba014049b5de8fad49d25424df2f1f6a8c1`).
